package com.acme.payments.validation;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.ZoneOffset;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.ValueSource;

class CardValidatorTest {

    private final CardValidator validator =
            new CardValidator(Clock.fixed(Instant.parse("2026-10-28T00:00:00Z"), ZoneOffset.UTC));

    @ParameterizedTest
    @ValueSource(strings = {"4111 1111 1111 1111", "5500-0000-0000-0004", "340000000000009"})
    void acceptsLuhnValidNumbers(final String pan) {
        assertThat(validator.isValidNumber(pan)).isTrue();
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsNull() {
        assertThat(validator.isValidNumber(null)).isFalse();
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsTooShort() {
        assertThat(validator.isValidNumber("4111 1111")).isFalse();
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsBadChecksum() {
        assertThat(validator.isValidNumber("4111 1111 1111 1112")).isFalse();
    }

    @Test
    void cardExpiringThisMonthIsNotExpired() {
        assertThat(validator.isExpired(10, 2026)).isFalse();
    }
